import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 66;
    static int r, c, n;
    static String s;
    static long[][] comb = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] cntA = new int[MAXN], cntB = new int[MAXN];
    static ArrayList<Long>[] part = new ArrayList[MAXN], partZero = new ArrayList[MAXN];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        r = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        s = br.readLine();
        n = 2 * (r + c);
        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            part[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            partZero[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        generate_combinations();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            cntA[i] = cntA[i - 1] + (s.charAt(i - 1) == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cntB[i] = cntB[i - 1] + (s.charAt(i - 1) == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        process_second_part();
        System.out.println(solve());
    }

    static void generate_combinations() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static long compute_diff(int conf, int a_prev, int b_prev) {
        long total_diff = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            if ((conf & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                b_prev++;
                total_diff -= comb[b_prev - 1][r - 1] * (comb[n - b_prev][r] - comb[a_prev][r]);
            } else {
                a_prev++;
                total_diff += comb[a_prev - 1][r - 1] * (comb[n - a_prev][r] - comb[b_prev][r]);
            }
        }
        return total_diff;
    }

    static boolean is_valid_conf(int conf) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            char ch = s.charAt(2 * r + c + i);
            if (ch == 'A' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 1) return false;
            if (ch == 'B' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void process_second_part() {
        int total_conf = 1 << (c + 1);
        for (int conf = 0; conf < total_conf; conf++) {
            int b_count = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_count = c + 1 - b_count;
            if (is_valid_conf(conf))
                part[a_count].add(compute_diff(conf, r + c - a_count, r + c - b_count));
            else
                partZero[a_count].add(compute_diff(conf, r + c - a_count, r + c - b_count));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            Collections.sort(part[i]);
            Collections.sort(partZero[i]);
        }
    }

    static long get_coefficient(int conf) {
        int i;
        for (i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            if ((((conf >> i) & 1) != (conf & 1))) break;
        }
        for (int j = i; j <= c; j++) {
            char ch = s.charAt(2 * r - 1 + j);
            if (ch == 'A' && (((conf >> j) & 1) == 1)) return 0;
            if (ch == 'B' && (((conf >> j) & 1) == 0)) return 0;
        }
        int setA = r - 1 + (((conf & 1) == 0) ? i : 0);
        int setB = r - 1 + (((conf & 1) == 1) ? i : 0);
        if (setA < cntA[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        if (setB < cntB[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        int total = setA + setB - cntA[2 * r - 2 + i] - cntB[2 * r - 2 + i];
        int choose = setA - cntA[2 * r - 2 + i];
        return comb[total][choose];
    }

    static long solve() {
        int total_conf = 1 << (c + 1);
        long[] answer = {Long.MAX_VALUE, 0};
        for (int conf = 0; conf < total_conf; conf++) {
            int b_count = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_count = c + 1 - b_count;
            long act = compute_diff(conf, r - 1, r - 1);
            long coef = get_coefficient(conf);
            int index = Collections.binarySearch(part[c + 1 - a_count], -act);
            if (index >= 0) {
                long val = part[c + 1 - a_count].get(index);
                if (answer[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    long count = count_in_vector(part[c + 1 - a_count], val);
                    update_answer(answer, new long[]{Math.abs(val + act), coef * count});
                }
            }
            int insertPoint = -Collections.binarySearch(part[c + 1 - a_count], -act) - 1;
            if (insertPoint > 0) {
                long val = part[c + 1 - a_count].get(insertPoint - 1);
                if (answer[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    long count = count_in_vector(part[c + 1 - a_count], val);
                    update_answer(answer, new long[]{Math.abs(val + act), coef * count});
                }
            }
            long zero_coef = 0;
            int indexZero = Collections.binarySearch(partZero[c + 1 - a_count], -act);
            if (indexZero >= 0) {
                long val = partZero[c + 1 - a_count].get(indexZero);
                long count = count_in_vector(part[c + 1 - a_count], val);
                if (answer[0] >= Math.abs(val + act))
                    update_answer(answer, new long[]{Math.abs(val + act), zero_coef * count});
            }
            int insertPointZero = -Collections.binarySearch(partZero[c + 1 - a_count], -act) - 1;
            if (insertPointZero > 0) {
                long val = partZero[c + 1 - a_count].get(insertPointZero - 1);
                long count = count_in_vector(part[c + 1 - a_count], val);
                if (answer[0] >= Math.abs(val + act))
                    update_answer(answer, new long[]{Math.abs(val + act), zero_coef * count});
            }
        }
        return answer[1];
    }

    static long count_in_vector(List<Long> data, long val) {
        int low = Collections.binarySearch(data, val);
        if (low < 0) low = -low - 1;
        int up = Collections.binarySearch(data, val);
        if (up < 0) up = -up - 1;
        else {
            while (up < data.size() && data.get(up) == val) up++;
        }
        return up - low;
    }

    static void update_answer(long[] ans, long[] act) {
        if (act[0] < 0) act[0] = -act[0];
        if (ans[0] > act[0]) {
            ans[0] = act[0];
            ans[1] = act[1];
        } else if (ans[0] == act[0]) {
            ans[1] += act[1];
        }
    }
}
